acceptance: npm run docs:check fails when a bash example in usage/cli-quick-start.md uses an option not in cli.commands, a value outside that option's exported choices, or a --platform value that resolves to no key in platforms.entries (after manifest aliases and the base:mode base); seeded-drift tests prove each failure, an alias control passes, and the real current bundle reports 0 violations.
context: Review 2026-10-28: VALID but narrower. No core/schema change needed: doc-contracts.json already exports platforms.entries (53), platform_manifest.aliases, per-option choices. options.ts already checks --platform where --platform-option is present. Site-only change in docs-contracts/checks/commands.ts, lib/types.ts, test/fixture.ts, test/checks.test.ts. Run block mode against the real bundle before merge: a false positive stops deploys.
description: The documentation contract checks in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site do not cover docs/usage/cli-quick-start.md or the values given to --platform in documentation examples, so a stale command or platform name there passes docs:check. Noted during the site-contract-checks work and left open.
